Durations range 0.8098–7.201 seconds, aggregate 337.61 seconds (5 minutes 37.61 seconds). Every clip has decoded PCM, with report containing byte checksum and decoded duration/energy measurement per file.

92 of 94 learner cards have a direct source audio reference; two absent IDs mb1m-lu-4120 and mb1m-lu-4131; 81 of 149 distinct source clips referenced, 68 additional archival MP3 kept immutable. All 81 reference targets exist and byte-verify.

Negative decoder controls on empty byte string and all-zero damaged MP3 both rejected; exact full 149-clip audit independently reran twice with SHA-identical JSON output ad71a9baecd18f638b0020a7656a0c29b09788d413c8761d4ed4b6523ebccb2e.
